title: Elf Bar Plus50 Grape Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Grape from the Elf Bar Plus50 pod range delivers a bold burst of juicy flavour with deep, candy-like sweetness and a subtle tang. This rich, full-bodied Grape blend makes for an intensely satisfying vape that remains clean and balanced throughout. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and comes paired with a 10ml refill tank for easy top-ups and long-lasting flavour. Designed for use with the Elf Bar Plus50 Kit, these pods feature mesh coil technology for a consistently smooth and flavoursome mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape.
